mentions.name: Offline Translator for Android
mentions.description: An Android app that provides translation entirely offline. It offers text translation plus OCR-based translation from images, functioning as a rough offline alternative to Google Translate and Google Lens, and now includes text-to-speech support built on multiple inference pipelines with models covering about 50 languages. The app works without internet connectivity and without any Google services.
mentions.problem: Provides translation without needing Google services or an internet connection.
